author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: RAKwireless has released the WisMesh RAK3312 Starter Kit, a modular LoRa mesh communication kit based on the company’s WisBlock ecosystem. The kit is intended for building private, off-grid communication networks using the open-source Meshtastic firmware, without requiring manual firmware flashing or custom hardware assembly. title: RAKwireless rolls out WisMesh RAK3312 Meshtastic LoRa starter kit
